event: Service Tax (Rate of Digital Services Tax) Order 2019 made
architecture_change: Creates rate order that states the digital-services tax regime will commence 2020-01-01

event: Service tax on covered digital services by foreign registered persons comes into operation
architecture_change: Provider-centered cross-border digital-service collection rail becomes operative

event: Sales tax imposition on low-value goods begins after legislation had come into force in 2023
architecture_change: Extends digital-commerce fiscal intermediation to LVG sellers including online marketplace operators; separate instrument from SToDS

event: PMSE VAT collection regime becomes effective
architecture_change: DGT-appointed PMSE actors collect remit report VAT on covered imported intangible goods/services

event: 242 active PMSE VAT collectors; 223 reported as having collected/remitted; cumulative PMSE VAT reported through this date
architecture_change: Shows an operational remitter population and reported collection scale; does not identify causal policy effects

event: Electronic tax portal for foreign suppliers launched
architecture_change: Creates a direct registration declaration and payment rail for foreign suppliers; precursor to later seller-platform withholding architecture
Creates the operative platform tax-administration framework used for covered household/individual seller activity
Per-transaction platform withholding/declaration/payment mechanism becomes legally operative
Carries the relevant household/individual tax-administration layer forward while preserving Decree 117 platform responsibility

event: Decree 141/2026/ND-CP issued with specified provisions effective from 2026-01-01
architecture_change: Amends specified Decree 68 thresholds/provisions; no frozen evidence that it displaces the Decree 117 per-transaction mechanism used in the paper

event: Nonresident electronic-service/platform VAT provisions enter their operative tax phase
architecture_change: Foreign electronic-service providers and qualifying continuous-process platforms enter the VES collection/filing architecture
Adds digital services to VAT framework and establishes provider marketplace and reverse-charge responsibility paths
Specifies location evidence NRDSP registration and operational implementation rules

event: NRDSPs become subject to VAT after the amended transition period
architecture_change: Moves the statutory/regulatory design into the operative VAT period for nonresident digital service providers
Provides VDS portal procedures for registration filing and payment
